title: Vaccine Responses to Influenza A H1N1/09 Immunization in High-risk Patients
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to assess vaccine responses to novel adjuvanted influenza A(H1N1) vaccines in patients at high risks of influenza A(H1N1) complications.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* medically recommended influenza A(H1N1) immunization
* signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* failure or refusal to provide sufficient blood for antibody determination
